notes.title: Reworked Nodes Demo
notes.notes:
Lately, I have been working on completely recreating Nodes from the ground up for about 2 or 3 months now, which is shown in screenshots of the game on it's Steam Page. Soon, a Demo of this new version will be released to the public. I'm not sure when, but expect it in about 2 or 3 weeks time.

I'll be sure to post frequent updates of the games progress either here, or on my discord server!

notes.title: Nodes Online Mode is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Sometime soon, Nodes will or will not get an online mode. It'll probably be built into the game at no extra cost. If I can't do that, though, I'll make it a seperate game and it will be free to play. I'm not too sure yet. But I'll try to keep everyone updated! :)

-Dreemore

notes.title: Nodes Playtest is released!
notes.notes:
Yeah, Nodes Playtest is released! A nice chance to play the game's upcoming features and beta releases before the actual game comes out, which could take months, or even years at this rate (lol). Keep in mind that the playtest versions of the game are [b]very[/b] buggy and unpolished. Depending on your device, the game might struggle to get even 20fps at times. But I'm sure in a few weeks or months, the game will have no issue running on whatever you have.

Have fun!
